title: MASTERMIND - Azimut Grande 27M
description:
MASTERMIND is a 2019 Azimut Grande 27M accommodating ten guests in five cabins, including a spacious on-deck master, all with en-suite facilities.

Generous decks for lounging and alfresco dining are complemented by a beach club and tender garage. Competitively priced and in pristine condition, she is lying in West Palm Beach, Florida.
